outcomes.title: Engineering knowledge
outcomes.text: Apply mathematics, science and engineering fundamentals to engineering problems.

outcomes.title: Problem analysis
outcomes.text: Identify, formulate and analyse problems to reach substantiated conclusions.

outcomes.title: Design of solutions
outcomes.text: Design systems, components or processes that meet stated needs.

outcomes.title: Investigation
outcomes.text: Use experiments, data analysis and research methods to reach valid conclusions.

outcomes.title: Modern tools
outcomes.text: Select and use appropriate techniques, software and tools.

outcomes.title: Ethics
outcomes.text: Apply professional ethics and responsibilities in engineering practice.

outcomes.title: Teamwork
outcomes.text: Work effectively as a member or leader of a team.

outcomes.title: Communication
outcomes.text: Communicate effectively in writing and speech.

outcomes.title: Lifelong learning
outcomes.text: Recognise the need for, and engage in, independent learning.

outcomes.title: Software development
outcomes.text: Develop correct, efficient software using suitable data structures and algorithms.

outcomes.title: Data and systems
outcomes.text: Design and manage data-intensive and computing systems.
